- **US-DTRANS-02** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — Sync incremental medrec (source: `US-D-TRANSFORMER-02`)

- **US-DTRANS-05** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — Lookup regpas by medrec / NIK / IHS (source: `US-D-TRANSFORMER-05`)
- **US-DTRANS-06** ([D09.01](../../modules/D-corporate.md#f-d09-01)) — List resource options (source: `US-D-TRANSFORMER-06`)
